sql: SELECT "player_award_vote"."player_id" AS k, ("player_award_vote"."points_max" - "player_award_vote"."points_won") AS m1 FROM "player_award_vote" WHERE ("player_award_vote"."points_max" - "player_award_vote"."points_won") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: player_award_vote.maximum possible points minus voting points won
why: maximum possible points - voting points won: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same player's vote result per award-year
rank player_award_vote rows by maximum possible points minus voting points won

sql: SELECT "home_game"."team_id" AS k, (CAST("home_game"."openings" AS REAL) / "home_game"."games") AS m1 FROM "home_game" WHERE (CAST("home_game"."openings" AS REAL) / "home_game"."games") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: home_game.home openings (dates with games) relative to home games
why: home openings (dates with games) / home games: a ratio of two quantities in count
rank home_game rows by home openings (dates with games) relative to home games

sql: SELECT "fielding_outfield"."player_id" AS k, ("fielding_outfield"."gcf" - "fielding_outfield"."glf") AS m1 FROM "fielding_outfield" WHERE ("fielding_outfield"."gcf" - "fielding_outfield"."glf") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: fielding_outfield.games in center field minus games in left field
why: games in center field - games in left field: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same player-season-stint outfield games
rank fielding_outfield rows by games in center field minus games in left field

sql: SELECT "hall_of_fame"."player_id" AS k, (CAST("hall_of_fame"."needed" AS REAL) / "hall_of_fame"."ballots") AS m1 FROM "hall_of_fame" WHERE (CAST("hall_of_fame"."needed" AS REAL) / "hall_of_fame"."ballots") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: hall_of_fame.votes needed for election relative to ballots cast
why: votes needed for election / ballots cast: a ratio of two quantities in count
rank hall_of_fame rows by votes needed for election relative to ballots cast

sql: SELECT "player_award_vote"."player_id" AS k, (CAST("player_award_vote"."points_won" AS REAL) / "player_award_vote"."points_max") AS m1 FROM "player_award_vote" WHERE (CAST("player_award_vote"."points_won" AS REAL) / "player_award_vote"."points_max") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: player_award_vote.voting points won relative to maximum possible points
why: voting points won / maximum possible points: a ratio of two quantities in points
rank player_award_vote rows by voting points won relative to maximum possible points
